final_objective.what_system_does: SuperEzio is a local financial copilot that routes user trade/order questions through Bob, the expert committee, guardrails, market data, and IBKR paper execution/audit surfaces.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 validating Bob before any real-money discussion.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Open http://127.0.0.1:8002, inspect live IBKR paper state, ask Bob for analysis/order, Bob must use tools and submit only gated paper LMT orders.
final_objective.start_command: python -m agent_server.main or python -m uvicorn agent_server.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002
final_objective.proof_output: /cockpit/portfolio and the browser cockpit show the same IBKR paper positions and open orders using broker-sourced identifiers.
final_objective.blocking_ready: 24/7 autonomous operation still needs longer supervised soak, fill-vs-submitted reconciliation, and explicit live-money kill gates before any production-money claim.

what_was_done: Fixed IBKR open-order mirror identity: IBKR/TWS can return repeated orderId values across clients, so cockpit now keys orders by permId first and preserves tws_order_id/client_id for audit.
Fixed IBKRService open-order refresh: uses reqAllOpenOrders/reqOpenOrders return values and ib_insync sleep so socket events are processed before reading openTrades/trades.
Fixed cockpit mirror UI: open IBKR orders and IBKR positions render together; local PaperJournal is labeled as local audit history, not broker state.
Hardened paper execution path: IBKR adapter now blocks market orders by default, requires limit_price for LMT, and calls scripts/_ibkr_order.py with the correct CLI argument contract.
Moved AutonomousLoop default away from simulated TradingEngine; default engine is LiveTradingEngine unless SUPEREZIO_AUTONOMOUS_ENGINE=simulated is set.

risks: First /cockpit/portfolio call immediately after API restart can be empty until IBKRService warms its cache; second call after worker refresh showed correct live state.
A submitted paper LMT order is not the same thing as a broker fill; UI and Bob must keep submitted/open/filled separated.
Autonomous live engine can submit paper orders when gates approve; keep this supervised until a longer soak proves no runaway behavior.

next_step: Add broker reconciliation loop: compare PaperJournal, IBKR open orders, IBKR executions/fills, and positions on every cycle; mark mismatches as BLOCK before Bob can claim a trade result.
